about: One row per concept in the eight lecture decks. status is Built (code and a test), Documented (a written analysis the deck asks for), Manual (a procedure a person runs) or Out of scope (cannot be built inside a web app, with the reason in OUT-OF-SCOPE.md). npm run concepts checks every file and test named here and rewrites CONCEPT-COVERAGE.md.

concepts.concept: Attack surface created by each feature
concepts.how: Every feature is analysed for how it can be abused
